html.name: HTML
steps: Open your site's HTML file.
Paste the embed code right before the </body> tag.
Save, reload the page and check the chat window in the corner.

wordpress.name: WordPress
steps: Install a code-injection plugin such as WPCode (or open Appearance > Theme file editor).
Paste the embed code into the Footer, before </body>.
Save and reload the page to check.

ladipage.name: LadiPage
steps: Open the page in LadiPage and go to Settings > Custom code.
Paste the embed code into the BODY box (end of page), before </body>.
Publish the page again.

haravan.name: Haravan
steps: Go to Website > Themes > Edit code.
Open theme.liquid and paste the embed code before </body>.
Save and reload the store.

sapo.name: Sapo
steps: Go to Website > Themes > Edit code.
Open theme.liquid and paste the embed code before </body>.
Save and reload the website.

shopify.name: Shopify
steps: Go to Online Store > Themes > Edit code.
Open theme.liquid and paste the embed code before </body>.
Save and reload the store.

wix.name: Wix
steps: Go to Settings > Custom Code > Add Code (needs a paid plan with a connected domain).
Paste the embed code, choose Body - end and apply to All pages.
Click Apply, then Publish.

gtm.name: Google Tag Manager
steps: Create a new tag of type Custom HTML.
Paste the embed code as the tag content and pick the All Pages trigger.
Click Submit, then Publish the container.
